Mr G v Gamma Logistics — Preliminary Hearing

Case number
3300555/2024
Decision date
4 February 2024
Jurisdiction code
Unfair Dismissal
Decision
Preliminary hearing: case-management orders only.

Reasons

This was a preliminary hearing convened to determine case-management directions for a forthcoming merits hearing. No findings on the merits of the unfair-dismissal complaint were made. Section 98 ERA 1996 was referenced only to scope the issues for the merits hearing.
